name: SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS: RADUKAR THE BEAST
description: Radukar the Beast has become ever more monstrous since the full power of his curse manifested. He transformed into a terrifying creature – the injuries that threatened to end him eclipsed by raw strength. This altered Radukar is a towering creature with dagger-length claws, capable of moving with a swiftness that seems impossible for his size.</br></br>This multipart plastic kit builds Radukar the Beast, a terrifying warrior for your Soulblight Gravelords armies in games of Warhammer Age of Sigmar. This apex warrior is ideal for tearing a path through even the toughest of enemy units, and leaving nothing behind but bloody remains. Radukar is a bestial monstrosity whose size is further amplified by his stunning scenic base.</br></br>This kit comprises 29 plastic components and 1x Citadel 60mm Round Base. This miniature requires assembly and is supplied unpainted – we recommend using Citadel Plastic Glue and Citadel Colour paints.
